product: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 Vegetation Indices (HLSL30_VI, HLSS30_VI)
native_res: 30 m pixel, every Landsat 8/9 and Sentinel-2 overpass

sampling.qa_rule: keep an observation only if the HLS Fmask (from HLSL30.020 / HLSS30.020, joined on date) has bits 1 cloud, 2 adjacent cloud/shadow, 3 cloud shadow and 4 snow/ice all 0, and NDVI is within -1..1. Water (bit 5) is kept, since a flooded paddy is a real field state
sampling.statistic: Landsat and Sentinel-2 samples pooled; mean per year-month, then p20, p50, p80 across years per calendar month (linear-interpolated percentiles)

low_ndvi_rule: calendar months whose p50 NDVI is below 0.4. A simple threshold for 'little green cover' (bare, flooded or just planted), not a crop calendar

provenance.source: NASA LP DAAC HLSL30_VI v2.0 and HLSS30_VI v2.0 (NDVI), Fmask from HLSL30 v2.0 and HLSS30 v2.0
provenance.native_res: 30 m, irregular revisit (about 2 to 3 days combined, fewer clear days)
provenance.note: Early years have fewer overpasses (Sentinel-2 from late 2015, Landsat 9 from late 2021), so n_samples per month varies.
